text: Novo retains obesity and diabetes as its core while extending its portfolio across blood, endocrine, liver and cardiovascular disease. Management identifies M&A as an available mechanism for adding external drug assets, particularly outside the core.

meta.note: Potential transactions remain unspecified; M&A is recorded only as an available integration mechanism.

text: Kalshi Klear filed with the CFTC to permit margin on eligible event contracts. Access would be limited to qualifying self-clearing members, with capital requirements increasing near expiry. Sports, culture and mention contracts would remain excluded.

meta.note: Margin availability remains contingent on regulatory approval and contract eligibility.
